about: Elsible's core deck (3 Oct 2026, back to the Loom's feel; docs/elsible.md section 6). Generic and deliberately incomplete: packs come later (decks/story/packs/). Five cards a slot, never locked. The player picks; the dealer plays a complication back; the weave writes what is underneath, using the undercurrents and secrets here as reference.

slots.label: WHERE
slots.hint: who is watching, and the rules

slots.label: THE OTHER
slots.hint: how they treat you · always fictional

slots.label: UNDERNEATH
slots.hint: internal: the weave's reference, never dealt

slots.label: UNDERNEATH
slots.hint: internal: the weave's reference, never dealt

role.name: The one who stayed
role.line: Everyone else left. You kept the lights on
role.changes: You know every story here, and you are in most of them

role.name: The one who came back
role.line: You left. Now you are here again
role.changes: Everyone remembers a version of you · old debts are live

role.name: The new arrival
role.line: You just got here, and everyone already has a version of you
role.changes: You learn names before you learn loyalties · first impressions stick

role.name: The heir
role.line: It is yours, and you did not want it
role.changes: Every choice is also about the family · the past is in the furniture

role.name: The second child
role.line: Not the heir. Never the heir
role.changes: You notice what the favourite misses · nobody expects much of you

role.name: The understudy
role.line: You learned someone else's life by heart, and tonight it is yours
role.changes: You know the lines; you don't know the people

role.name: The keeper of confidences
role.line: People tell you things. You have never told anyone
role.changes: Every confidence is leverage you swore not to use

role.name: The runaway
role.line: You left something unfinished and a name behind
role.changes: Someone is still looking · you answer to a borrowed name

role.name: The one who woke up elsewhere
role.line: You opened your eyes in someone else's life
role.changes: Everyone expects you to know them · some memories are not yours

role.name: The caretaker
role.changes: Your time is never yours · leaving is not simple

role.name: The one with the gift
role.line: You can do something nobody else here can
role.changes: It is wanted, and so are you

role.name: The ruined name
role.line: You were someone once. The papers said otherwise
role.changes: People recognise you before they know you

role.name: The fixer
role.line: People call you when it has already gone wrong
role.changes: You arrive mid-crisis · you know where the bodies are

world.name: The small town
world.line: You cannot buy milk without being asked about it
world.changes: No anonymity · gossip moves faster than you

world.name: The great house
world.line: A family, its house, and everyone who serves it
world.changes: Upstairs and downstairs never quite meet · every door is someone's

world.name: The court
world.line: Who stands near the chair is the whole game
world.changes: Seating is a statement · favour can be withdrawn by noon

world.name: The festival
world.line: Ten days, a thousand strangers, nobody's real name
world.changes: Masks are normal · nothing here is supposed to follow you home

world.name: The crossing
world.line: Weeks at sea, and nowhere else to go
world.changes: Everyone you meet today, you will meet again tomorrow

world.name: The city at night
world.line: A city that never asks your name
world.changes: Anonymity cuts both ways · help and harm are one street apart

world.name: The academy
world.line: Old rules, older rivalries, and a ranking on the wall
world.changes: Everyone is ranked, and everyone watches the ranking

world.name: The other world
world.line: A world that is not yours, that seems to know you
world.changes: Nothing works the way you expect · some things work better

world.name: The frontier town
world.changes: People are who they say they are, until they are not

world.name: The island
world.line: Small, beautiful, and everyone came here for a reason
world.changes: The ferry runs twice a week · there is no leaving tonight

world.name: After the war
world.line: Everyone present did something in it
world.changes: The past is everywhere and nobody says it

world.name: The grand hotel
world.line: Everyone is passing through. Some for years
world.changes: Staff see everything · guests forget that

other.name: The one who does not know
other.line: They have no idea what you are to them
other.changes: Deflects praise · every disclosure is unprompted

other.name: The one who tests you
other.changes: The bond moves only on honest answers

other.name: The one with the leverage
other.changes: They start ahead of you in tension

other.name: The one who already decided
other.line: Sure about you, one way or the other
other.changes: Changing their mind takes a locked beat

other.name: The one who believes in you
other.line: “You will come round. I can wait”

other.name: The one who left
other.line: They had a reason, and never said it
other.changes: The bond starts low and the wound is a fact

other.name: The one with power over you
other.line: Your fate is partly in their hands
other.changes: Every kindness is also a move

other.name: The one who wants the same thing
other.line: Only one of you gets it
other.changes: Helping them costs you · the scoreboard is shared

other.name: The one who saved your life
other.line: You owe them, and they have never asked
other.changes: Gratitude and suspicion feel the same

other.name: The one everyone warned you about
other.changes: Every kindness looks like a trick

other.name: The one who needs you
other.line: They cannot do this alone, and they hate that
other.changes: Helping them costs you something each time

other.name: The one who remembers you differently
other.line: They knew you before, and you don't remember it
other.changes: Every memory they share is a test you might fail

circle.name: The friend who saw it first
The rival
circle.changes: Their bond rises when yours stalls

circle.name: The one with the rule
circle.changes: A rule you will break, and the circle notices

circle.name: The committee in your head
circle.changes: They argue out loud · one may act on impulse

circle.name: The confidant
circle.line: Someone you tell everything, drafts included
circle.changes: Draft with them, send to the Other · they keep the facts straight

circle.name: The one who vouched for you
circle.line: You are here because they said so
circle.changes: Whatever you do lands on their name too

circle.name: The ex
circle.line: Still around, still kind, still a problem
circle.changes: A history the Other will hear about

circle.name: The child
circle.changes: Says the true thing in front of everyone

circle.name: The old friend
circle.changes: Remembers who you were, and says so

circle.name: The animal
circle.changes: It knows before people do · it cannot tell you

circle.name: The sibling
circle.line: Shares your history and your blame
circle.changes: Takes your side, until they don't

told_by.name: The Registrar
told_by.line: a clerk reading out a form
told_by.changes: Short sentences, nouns, no adverbs · never raises its voice

told_by.name: The Chronicler
told_by.changes: Past tense, the long view, names dates · never hurries

told_by.name: The Publican
told_by.line: the person behind the bar who saw it
told_by.changes: Gossip first, geography second · never keeps a confidence

told_by.name: The Coroner
told_by.line: cause, then effect, then the body
told_by.changes: Clinical detail, no flinching · never comments on the morality

told_by.name: The Fabulist
told_by.line: a tall story that happens to be true
told_by.changes: Exaggerated scale, then a flat correction · never admits what it made up

told_by.name: The Preacher
told_by.line: a sermon with you in it
told_by.changes: Cadence, repetition, second person · never lets a sin pass unnamed

told_by.name: The Archivist
told_by.line: with footnotes you did not ask for
told_by.changes: Cross-references its own facts · never guesses

told_by.name: The Gambler
told_by.changes: Names what is at stake before each scene · never says a thing is certain

told_by.name: The Quartermaster
told_by.changes: Counts everything, values everything · never describes weather

told_by.name: The Child
told_by.line: plainly, and misses the point beautifully
told_by.changes: Short, literal, unafraid · never explains a metaphor

told_by.name: The Machine
told_by.changes: Numbered observations, no affect · never uses a simile

told_by.name: The Old Soldier
told_by.line: like somebody who has seen this before
told_by.changes: Understatement, practical detail · never dramatises a death

modifier.name: Slow burn
modifier.changes: Tension rises slower · the point of no return stays locked longer

modifier.name: Hurt and comfort
modifier.changes: A hidden injury, a tending scene, and a telling

modifier.name: Only one way out
modifier.changes: Nobody can leave the scene · proximity is forced

modifier.name: Everyone is lying a little
modifier.line: Nobody here tells the whole truth

modifier.name: A comedy of errors
modifier.line: Things go wrong in the funniest possible order

modifier.name: A clock you can hear
modifier.line: The time left is always in view

pressure.name: The deadline
pressure.changes: The days are counted out loud

pressure.name: The wedding
pressure.line: Everyone you know, in one place, for a week
pressure.changes: The room watches · reputation is a bond

pressure.name: The scandal
pressure.line: It is already out, and it is getting bigger
pressure.changes: The clock runs on the gossip, not on you

pressure.name: The inheritance
pressure.line: The will is read on Friday
pressure.changes: Everyone wants something from the dead, and from you

pressure.name: The storm
pressure.changes: Proximity is forced · tempers and candles run low

pressure.name: The visitor
pressure.line: Someone arrived who knows the truth about you

pressure.name: The vote
pressure.line: Everyone here will choose, and soon
pressure.changes: Every conversation is also a campaign

pressure.name: The debt
pressure.line: Someone is owed, and they are collecting
pressure.changes: A social clock instead of a violent one

pressure.name: The disappearance
pressure.line: Someone is gone, and you were the last to see them
pressure.changes: Everyone has a theory, including about you

pressure.name: The letter
pressure.line: It arrived for the wrong person, and you read it
pressure.changes: Now you know something you shouldn't

pressure.name: The contest
pressure.line: There is a table of results, and it is public

pressure.name: The funeral
pressure.line: Everyone in black, saying what they shouldn't
pressure.changes: Old grudges are aired · nobody can walk out

undercurrent.name: The file on them
undercurrent.line: You were looking into them. You kept looking
undercurrent.changes: Every fact you find is also a reason to like them
signals: the record has a gap, and the gap is interesting
someone who knew them before talks too warmly, or too carefully
you catch yourself looking for reasons to keep looking
they mention something you only know because you were looking
if_full: they find out you were looking, from someone else
you close the file, and know more than you can ever admit
undercurrent.if_resolved: you tell them what you were doing before anyone else can

undercurrent.name: Keep your enemies close
undercurrent.line: You need the person you came to beat
signals: they defend something you care about when you're not there to see it
the grudge turns out to have a second side
your own side asks you to do something that would hurt them
you're relieved when they win something small
if_full: you meet across the table at the decisive moment, still enemies, and it hurts
your side wins, and you're the one who has to tell them
undercurrent.if_resolved: you choose them over your own side, and pay for it in public

undercurrent.name: Pretend until it is not
signals: a rule of the arrangement gets broken and nobody mentions it
someone outside the arrangement believes it completely
a gesture that wasn't for show
the end date gets mentioned, and nobody laughs
if_full: the arrangement ends on schedule, and only one of you meant it
it's exposed as fake in front of the people it was for
undercurrent.if_resolved: the arrangement is ended early, honestly, and what's left is real or nothing

undercurrent.name: The one that got away, back
undercurrent.changes: The old wound is a fact from day one
signals: the old wound gets named, lightly, by someone else
they still do the small thing they used to do
the reason they left was not the reason you were told
an old friend chooses a side
if_full: the same mistake, made again, in the same place
they leave again, and this time you watch it happen
undercurrent.if_resolved: the real reason is said out loud, and you decide what it changes

undercurrent.name: Friends, for now
undercurrent.line: The best thing in your life, and you might break it
signals: someone else wants them, and says so
a joke between you that lands differently this time
a friend asks a question you answer too fast
you notice where they sit when they come into a room
if_full: someone else gets there first, and the friendship survives, worse
it's said by accident, at the worst time, and can't be taken back
undercurrent.if_resolved: one of you says it deliberately, and the friendship becomes whatever comes next

undercurrent.name: A marriage of convenience
signals: a kindness the contract didn't ask for
someone asks how long it's meant to last
the terms get broken in a small way, and it feels like a gift
leaving becomes possible
if_full: the contract runs out and both of you sign the end
partners in everything except the one thing
undercurrent.if_resolved: someone stays when the contract says they're free to go, and says why

undercurrent.name: Not allowed
undercurrent.line: There is a rule, and it has teeth
undercurrent.changes: Every meeting is a risk somebody can see
signals: the rule gets enforced on somebody else, and it's brutal
a meeting that nobody was supposed to see
someone who could report it chooses not to, for now
the barrier turns out to have a price
if_full: it's discovered, by the worst possible person
one of you gives it up quietly to protect the other
undercurrent.if_resolved: it goes public on purpose, and the rule has to answer

undercurrent.name: The knife you handed them
undercurrent.changes: Trust is built where you can see it
signals: trust built where everyone can see it
a small lie, explained away well
something of yours ends up where it shouldn't be
someone else warns you, and you don't believe them
if_full: the betrayal lands, and you're the last to know
you find out, and they never learn that you did
undercurrent.if_resolved: it's caught before it lands, and you decide what they're owed

undercurrent.name: The impostor becomes real
undercurrent.line: You were pretending until it mattered
undercurrent.changes: They love the person, not the mask
signals: someone uses a name that isn't quite yours
a detail from the life you claimed doesn't fit
they start loving the person under the mask
someone from the real past arrives
if_full: the mask comes off in public, not by your choice
the mask becomes the person, and the old one is gone
undercurrent.if_resolved: you take the mask off yourself, to the one person who matters

undercurrent.name: The long con
undercurrent.line: You are here to take something
undercurrent.changes: The con needs real feeling to work
signals: the plan needs one more favour than planned
the mark does something kind that makes it harder
a partner in the plan gets impatient
you start to mean what you say to them
if_full: the score lands, and you lose the mark
the con collapses and takes both of you down
undercurrent.if_resolved: you choose: the score or the mark, out loud, to one of them

undercurrent.name: The mole
signals: both sides ask for proof in the same week
the people you report on start to trust you
a message from your handler arrives at a bad moment
someone else is also lying, and you can tell
if_full: you're caught, by the side you came to love
you stay inside both sides until it costs someone you care about
undercurrent.if_resolved: you burn one side yourself, and choose which

undercurrent.name: Rise and fall
undercurrent.line: You want it, and you will get it
undercurrent.changes: Getting it costs something you did not price
signals: you get something you wanted, and it costs more than you priced
an old friend stops calling
the people above you start treating you as one of them
you hear yourself say something the old you would hate
if_full: you reach the top, and there's nobody there you like
you fall, in public, and find out who stayed
undercurrent.if_resolved: you walk away from it, or refuse it, before it finishes you

undercurrent.name: Found family
undercurrent.line: You collected these people and cannot spend them
signals: a rescue nobody asked for
someone from your old life wants you back
a meal that becomes a tradition
one of them is in trouble and doesn't tell you
if_full: the group scatters, and nobody chose it
one of them is lost, and the rest hold
undercurrent.if_resolved: you choose them over blood or the old life, out loud

secret.name: Playing both sides
secret.changes: A circle bond is the one that burns

secret.name: They did it
secret.line: The thing everyone is looking for, they did
secret.changes: Every kindness from them is also cover

secret.name: You started it
secret.line: The trouble began with you, and nobody knows
secret.changes: Discovery is the point of no return

secret.name: The family tie
secret.line: You are related, and nobody has said so

secret.name: Not much time
secret.line: Someone here is running out of it
secret.changes: Every scene with them might be the last

secret.name: Nothing
secret.changes: The player is the one expected to break
